topic: Mohe 1997 eclipse gravity anomaly / 1.67 nT-uGal coupling — verify ISS-2590 detail_extra patch
change_summary: Decider self-applied ISS-2590 patch (commit e8db23c): removed unsupported Monte Carlo / 37%-of-red-noise quantitative assertions and the EM-forcing mechanism overstatement from detail_extra, replacing both with qualitative phrasing. This c4 verifies the patch closed c3 holes 1 and 2 without introducing new tu-quoque hooks.
our_argument_summary: WIN-011 (Not Demonstrated): the dome -6.5 uGal Mohe 1997 eclipse gravity anomaly rests on a marginal LaCoste-Romberg spring-gravimeter reading whose timing (first/last contact, not maximum) contradicts a shielding interpretation; the same lead observer (Yang & Wang 2002) later reported no significant anomaly; four superconducting gravimeters (Van Camp 2001) found nothing ~1000x more precisely; and the kappa=1.67 nT/uGal coupling is a circular ratio of two hardcoded constants validated against itself.

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: Dome derives coupling = 10.9 nT / 6.5 uGal = 1.67 nT/uGal (02-wins.txt:87, 05-model.txt:73). The live-power page displays Predicted: 1.67 | Observed: 1.677 | Tolerance: 5.0% | Status: PASS (08-live-power.txt:225) — a hardcoded predicted value compared to a hardcoded observed value.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: Hardcoded. The PASS line compares 1.67 (hardcoded) against 1.677 (the ratio of the two hardcoded inputs) at 5% tolerance — a display, not a live validation. No external data fetch.
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: 5% tolerance on a ratio of self-supplied constants; no adaptive logic observed for this domain.
dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: Our detail_evidence references Domain #7 in monitor.py. monitor.py is NOT present in the current raw-text/ capture (only the page .txt files are). The hardcoded claim is independently corroborated by 08-live-power.txt:225 (Predicted 1.67 / Observed 1.677 / 5% / PASS), so the conclusion stands, but the specific monitor.py / KAPPA reference cannot be re-validated against this snapshot — minor.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: 08-live-power.txt:225 shows Predicted 1.67 / Observed 1.677 / Tolerance 5.0% / Status PASS — both sides baked in, no API fetch. Consistent with wins.json code_analysis.monitoring=hardcoded.
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: Standard geophysics does not predict a -6.5 uGal eclipse gravity anomaly; the mainstream result (Van Camp 2001, four SGs) is a null. The dome is not renaming an accepted mechanism — it is asserting a disputed signal. false stands.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: The -6.5 uGal value is adopted from Wang et al. (2000) published years before the dome incorporated it; the dome restates a pre-existing (and contested) measured value rather than predicting it prospectively. true stands.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: -6.5 uGal is taken from the Mohe spring-gravimeter literature, not derived from disc_radius / firmament_height / aetheric parameters. The 1.67 coupling is a back-computed ratio of two adopted observations, not a geometric derivation. false stands.

patch_verification.c3_hole_1_status: CLOSED — removed text Monte Carlo simulation shows... and 37% of red-noise samples with realistic autocorrelation exceed this threshold. The bare 37% statistic and unshown Monte Carlo are gone; replaced with qualitative an asymmetry index near 1.15 is unremarkable for autocorrelated red-noise signals under these conditions. This is recommendation (b) from c3 hole 1. Tu-quoque hook removed.
patch_verification.c3_hole_2_status: CLOSED — replaced respond to the same massive electromagnetic forcing with driven by the same large-scale storm-time environmental forcing (atmospheric/ionospheric loading), exactly the c3 hole 2 recommendation. Mechanism is now physically correct (SGs respond to mass/loading, not nT-scale fields).
patch_verification.new_hooks_introduced: None. The numeric values still present in detail_extra (r=0.992, AI=1.152, 95.2%, Dst=-383 nT) are all attributed to the DOME as its own claims, not asserted by us, so no new tu-quoque exposure. No new un-shown statistics of our own were added.

holes_found.description: CARRY-OVER (still open from c3 hole 0, already tracked): the verdict-tightening question. Our detail_evidence quotes Yang & Wang (2002) — the dome source own lead observer — stating no significant anomaly during the very solar eclipse was found, plus the four-SG null (Van Camp 2001). That is closer to refutation than to Not Demonstrated, and WIN-011 is the softest verdict in the WIN-011/012/013/014 group (012 Self-Contradicted, 013/014 Refuted by Data). This is a judgement call, not a bug — Not Demonstrated remains defensible because a 1997 eclipse cannot be re-measured. Already captured as ISS-2589 (status assigned-analyst, strategic reframing in progress); flagging only so it is not lost, NOT recommending a fresh issue.
holes_found.recommendation: No new action — ISS-2589 (assigned-analyst) owns this. Decider should treat the unresolved_prior_cycle entry as already-assigned (no-op / do not double-create). When the analyst delivers the reframing EXP, re-evaluate whether to tighten the verdict to Refuted by Data.

stronger_arguments.description: Lead with the author self-retraction. The single strongest point is that the dome OWN source author (Yang & Wang 2002) reported no significant eclipse anomaly. That is more damaging than the external SG null because it removes the mainstream instruments are biased escape. Currently it is mid-paragraph in detail_evidence; promoting it (and the ISS-2589 reframing) would harden the WIN.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome is right that SOME gravimeter studies of the 1997 Mohe eclipse reported a small anomaly — Wang et al. (2000, Phys. Rev. D, doi:10.1103/PhysRevD.62.041101) did report ~6-7 uGal valleys, so the -6.5 uGal figure is not invented (WIN-011 detail_evidence cites the real source). A marginal signal did exist in the original spring-gravimeter record.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: The same record timing (first/last contact, not eclipse maximum, per WIN-011 detail_evidence) contradicts the shielding story, the lead author retracted it (Yang & Wang 2002), and four ~1000x-more-precise superconducting gravimeters found nothing (Van Camp 2001). A real-but-marginal artifact in one crude instrument, unreproduced by superior ones, does not establish dome EM-gravity coupling — and the 1.67 nT/uGal constant is a self-validating ratio of hardcoded inputs (08-live-power.txt:225 PASS line).

deeper_analysis: This is a clean verification pass. Commit e8db23c implemented c3 hole 1 recommendation (b) and hole 2 recommendation verbatim; both moderate/minor tu-quoque + mechanism holes are closed and no replacement introduced new un-shown statistics. The WIN now criticises the dome hardcoded Exhibit A statistics without asserting competing bare numbers of our own — the patch resolved the only real adversarial exposure c3 found. Remaining work is not a defect in the patch: (1) the verdict-tightening judgement call is already assigned to the analyst as ISS-2589; (2) a freshly-noticed staleness question about whether the dome still displays Exhibit A warrants a poller re-check but does not undermine the core argument. Verdict Not Demonstrated holds; recommended_action no_change for this patch verification.
